power.note: Predeclared 2026-11-03 before any game (board row 6, acceptance model). Candidate planner_offer_accept = served planner_offer_guard with each offer's gain and help penalty scaled by the recipient's public acceptance rate (accepted+2)/(answered+2), counting its answers to any seat this game; identical to the guard until a seat has answered. Control is the served planner_offer_guard (PR #19). Constant ACCEPT_PRIOR=2 fixed before any game; a fail parks the arm, no retuning. The arm passes only if BOTH configs pass: offer-accept-mixed-dev (improvement where the mechanism should bite: Builder and Expander refuse every offer) and offer-accept-dev (non-inferiority on the other tables). This config: tactical, self (three planner_offer_guard) and strict (three planner_strict_acceptor) tables, NON-INFERIORITY point floor: passes if every table's observed paired lift >= -.03 (a point-estimate floor, not confidence-based non-inferiority). 320 seeds per table.
